原文 阅读解析 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
Turing-complete - fundamental model for computing results and every computer has the ability to run any algorithm Turing-complete / - / fundamental model / for computing results / and / every computer / has the ability / to run any algorithm 图灵完备——用于计算结果的基础模型，且每台计算机都有运行任何算法的能力。 fundamental：基础的，基本的
algorithm：算法		 Turing-complete 是计算机科学术语。has the ability to do sth 表示“具有做某事的能力”。
vacuum tube - physical device that works like a light bulb used as memory in early digital computers vacuum tube / - / physical device / that works / like a light bulb / used as memory / in early digital computers 真空管——一种工作方式类似于灯泡的物理装置，在早期数字计算机中被用作存储器。 vacuum tube：真空管
physical device：物理设备
memory：存储器/内存		 that works like... 为定语从句修饰 device；used as memory 是过去分词短语作后置定语。
